ASBSkill.description: Collection-time aggregated skill record — the deduplicated, paper-grounded scientific competency surfaced by ``corpus_artifacts.collect_skills`` at release time. Distinct from ``SkillBundle`` which is the per-capsule artifact. Mirrors the Python dataclass at agentic_science_builder.schemas.ASBSkill (formerly SciSkill).

bundle_dir.description: Absolute path to the offline skill knowledge base bundle directory

description.description: Human-readable description of the collection's scope and thematic coherence

edam_operation.description: Primary EDAM operation IRI for this skill (e.g. http://edamontology.org/operation_3799)

edam_topics.description: Collection-level EDAM topic IRIs (anchors the whole release)

kb_path.description: Relative path to the skill's knowledge-base entry file

merged_alias_records.description: Per-merge audit records documenting alias deduplication decisions

merged_aliases.description: Original labels of skills merged into this canonical entry

related_tools.description: Canonical URLs / slugs of tools used by this skill

skill_name.description: Human-readable canonical name of the skill

source_paper_doi.description: Primary source paper DOI (flat field, complements source_papers[])

source_paper_title.description: Primary source paper title (flat field, complements source_papers[])

source_papers.description: Structured references to papers that contributed to this bundle

source_task_ids.description: task_id values of the ASB task cards from which this skill was extracted

when_to_use.description: Guidance on when and how to apply this skill

ASBSkill.title: ASBSkill

ASBTool.description: Collection-time aggregated tool record — the deduplicated, paper-grounded software-tool reference surfaced by ``corpus_artifacts.collect_tools``. Mirrors the Python dataclass at agentic_science_builder.schemas.ASBTool (formerly SciTool).

bio_tools_id.description: bio.tools identifier for this tool. Reserved slot for the future bio.tools federation work; not populated in v1.

canonical_url.description: Canonical URL for the tool (GitHub, bio.tools, PyPI, etc.)

edam_operation.description: Primary EDAM operation IRI for this skill (e.g. http://edamontology.org/operation_3799)

edam_topics.description: Collection-level EDAM topic IRIs (anchors the whole release)

evidence_spans.description: Verbatim quotes from source papers anchoring this tool reference

install.description: Install metadata dict (conda / pip / docker / etc.) produced by tool_resolver

related_skills.description: Slugs of ASBSkill records that reference this tool

resolution_attempts.description: Audit list of resolver attempts (each entry a dict; serialized as JSON)

source_paper_doi.description: Primary source paper DOI (flat field, complements source_papers[])

source_paper_title.description: Primary source paper title (flat field, complements source_papers[])

source_task_ids.description: task_id values of the ASB task cards from which this skill was extracted

tool_name.description: Tool name (mirrors ToolRecord.tool_name; used by ASBTool)

version_used.description: Version string actually used in the source paper(s)

ASBTool.title: ASBTool

Any.description: Unconstrained value. Used only for the inline JSON-LD `@context`, whose shape (IRI string, object or list) belongs to JSON-LD, not to this schema.
Any.title: Any

CollectionRoles.description: Attribution roles for the collection as a whole, mirroring the per-skill `attribution` block: what generated it, who promotes it, who paid for it, who curated it, and the author list deposited on Zenodo.

curators.description: People who modified or validated the content (may be empty)

generator.description: What produced the content (a pipeline, not a human author)

promoter.description: Person who proposes the collection for use

zenodo_authors.description: Creators as listed on the Zenodo deposit, in order

CollectionRoles.title: CollectionRoles

Curator.description: A lead curator as released manifests record one: display name, a bare ORCID iD and a GitHub handle. Distinct from Person, whose `orcid` is a URI; the manifest writer derives `contributors` from this list with the URI form.

orcid.description: Bare ORCID iD (0000-0000-0000-0000), not a URI

Curator.title: Curator

MergeAuditRecord.description: Per-merge audit record documenting alias deduplication decisions. Surfaces the data ``corpus_artifacts._semantic_dedup`` already records so dedup decisions are queryable and citable.

decided_at.description: When the merge decision was recorded (ISO 8601)

decided_by.description: Agent or person that made the decision (e.g. "agent:dedup", "orcid:0000-...")

edam_match.description: True when both records share an EDAM operation IRI

embedding_cosine.description: Cosine similarity of MiniLM embeddings (when semantic dedup ran)

jaccard_score.description: Token-set Jaccard similarity score used for the merge decision

llm_judge_verdict.description: Free-form judgement string from an LLM dedup judge (if used)

target_slug.description: Canonical slug this alias was merged into

MergeAuditRecord.title: MergeAuditRecord

MergeDecisionEnum.description: Possible outcomes recorded by a MergeAuditRecord
MergeDecisionEnum.title: MergeDecisionEnum

PaperReference.description: A reference to a source paper that contributed to this skill bundle.

relevance.description: Short note on the relevance of this paper to the skill

task_ids.description: task_id values from this paper that surfaced this skill

PaperReference.title: PaperReference

Person.description: A person, contributor at the collection level.
Person.title: Person

SkillBundle.description: A versioned, curated description of one reusable computational skill identified across multiple papers. Contains a human-readable skill description and 12 structured sidecars (papers, parameters, failure modes, tools, environments, links, etc.).

edam_operation.description: Primary EDAM operation IRI for this skill (e.g. http://edamontology.org/operation_3799)

merged_alias_records.description: Per-merge audit records documenting alias deduplication decisions

merged_aliases.description: Original labels of skills merged into this canonical entry

scripts.description: Paths to embedded script chunks from linked GitHub repositories (line-range copies, not full clones)

skill_description.description: Full description of the skill's purpose and scope

SkillCollection.description: A curated thematic release of N ASBSkills and M ASBTools, pinned by content-hash. Distinct from per-capsule SkillBundle; this is the release unit.

@context.description: Inline JSON-LD context of the manifest. Serialised as `@context`; opaque to this schema.

@id.description: JSON-LD node identifier; equal to `iri` in released manifests. Serialised as `@id`.

@type.description: JSON-LD type of the manifest node (e.g. asb:SkillCollection). Serialised as `@type`.

catalogue_membership.description: Higher-level catalogue IRIs that include this collection (typically the SkillCollectionRegistry root).

contributors.description: People who curated this collection (per-collection ORCIDs)

description.description: Human-readable description of the collection's scope and thematic coherence

doi.description: Zenodo DOI of this collection release (uriorcurie)

domain_topics.description: EDAM topic IRIs under the name the catalogue generator reads. Released manifests carry the same list as `edam_topics`.

edam_topics.description: Collection-level EDAM topic IRIs (anchors the whole release)

iri.description: Stable IRI for this collection release (e.g. w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-skill/collection/metabolomics/v1).

lead_curators.description: Lead curators of the release (see Curator).

ro_crate_path.description: Path to this collection's ro-crate-metadata.json (relative to release root)

skills.description: Content-hash-pinned references to ASBSkill entries included in this release. Each entry is an IRI of the form w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-skill/<slug>@sha256:<hash>

skills_count.description: Number of skills the release declares; read by the catalogue generator.

source_collections.description: Recursive — IRIs of prior collections this release is derived from (e.g. merged or split). Empty for fresh collections.

tools.description: Content-hash-pinned references to ASBTool entries used by this collection. Each entry is an IRI of the form w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-tool/<slug>@sha256:<hash>

tools_count.description: Number of tools the release declares; read by the catalogue generator.

version.description: Release version number (integer; matches the vN in the IRI)

workflows_count.description: Number of workflow directories the release ships, when declared; a release gate checks it against the tree.

zenodo_doi.description: Bare Zenodo DOI of the deposit (10.5281/zenodo.N), as recorded by the Zenodo release step. Released manifests carry the same value as `doi`.

SkillCollection.title: SkillCollection

SkillCollectionRegistry.description: Catalogue root for the `asb-skill-collections` repo. Lists every released SkillCollection, plus a reserved (v1-off) federation slot.

collections.description: IRIs of all SkillCollection releases catalogued by this registry. Each entry pins a specific version (e.g. w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-skill/collection/metabolomics/v1).

external_repos.description: RESERVED (off in v1). Future federation slot — IRIs of third-party `*-skill-collections` repos whose collections get aggregated into this catalogue. This is a design slot only.

generated_at.description: When this catalogue snapshot was generated (ISO 8601)

registry_iri.description: Stable IRI of this registry (e.g. w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-skill/)

registry_maintainers.description: People listed in MAINTAINERS.md who curate this registry

SkillCollectionRegistry.title: SkillCollectionRegistry

ToolAffordance.description: W3C WoT ActionAffordance-aligned mixin. RESERVED for v1 — slot definitions exist but no ASB class consumes them yet. When the ecosystem standardises on WoT for executable tools, ASBTool (or an ExecutableTool subclass) will inherit from this mixin without breaking existing instances.

effect.description: Free-form effect description for downstream agents

input_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's input payload (WoT ActionAffordance.input)

output_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's output payload (WoT ActionAffordance.output)

precondition.description: Free-form precondition (e.g. "requires CUDA 12.x") — WoT-style affordance hint

side_effect_free.description: True when invoking the tool has no observable side effects (pure function)
